INSERT INTO stock_daily_indicator (stock_id, trade_date, param_key, ema_fast, ema_slow, dif, dea, osc, rsv, k_value, d_value, j_value, is_warmup) VALUES
(#{r.stockId}, #{r.tradeDate}, #{r.paramKey}, #{r.emaFast}, #{r.emaSlow}, #{r.dif}, #{r.dea}, #{r.osc}, #{r.rsv}, #{r.kValue}, #{r.dValue}, #{r.jValue}, #{r.isWarmup})

mapper.select: SELECT stock_id, trade_date, param_key, ema_fast, ema_slow, dif, dea, osc, rsv, k_value, d_value, j_value, is_warmup FROM stock_daily_indicator WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND param_key = #{paramKey}
